task: T010 (specs/retrieval-quality-v2, FR-002) — seal: TC-006 empirical verification + TC-005 floors + TC-007 immutability

dataset.loader: cairn.eval.load_ground_truth (fails loudly on any shape violation)

verification.method: Fresh scratch graph build per corpus (vendored tree copied to a throwaway workspace; the COPY gets the empty .git scanner marker; cairn.graph.builder.build_graph over the workspace), then EVERY expectation resolved tier-1-exact against that build's full symbol inventory: exact symbol-name equality AND exact repo-relative file-path equality after stripping the corpus prefix. match_rank (the committed two-tier matcher) parity over the full pool: exact implies tier-1 (file suffix), tier-1 implies rank > 0.
verification.grade_scale: 2 = primary target (exactly one per query), 1 = must-return context

pins.algorithm: cairn.bench.datasource.tree_hash — Git-tree-shaped sorted-manifest digest: sha256 over sorted '<mode> <relpath>\0<sha256(content)>' entries (modes normalized git-style; .git dir contents and build-noise caches (__pycache__/.ruff_cache/.mypy_cache/.pytest_cache) excluded)
pins.corpora_scope: the vendored corpus source trees named by manifest.corpora.<name>.source
pins.dataset_content_scope: the dataset DATA pair only — queries.jsonl + expectations.tsv staged in a scratch dir and hashed with the same tree_hash function; manifest.json/VERIFICATION*/AUTHORING.md are excluded so the pin can never be self-referential
revisions: 2026-08-17 re-mint of corpora.attrs-26.1.0: the original pin 847e73ef... was minted over the authoring tree INCLUDING untracked build noise (a .ruff_cache dropped inside the vendored tree by pre-commit ruff runs), so a fresh clone failed the seal with 'corpus content drifted' despite 558/558 expectations verifying. tree_hash now prunes build-noise caches (hash-neutral for clean trees) and the pin was re-minted over the pristine HEAD tree (git-archive export, no local noise). The yarl pin b2ac9f50... and the dataset_content pin d83beefc... were minted over noise-free trees and verified unchanged under the hardened function; no corpus data or expectation row was touched.

tc007_ds_v1_immutability.method: git status --porcelain + git diff against HEAD over the DS-v1 paths (every DS-v1 artifact byte-identical); DS-v2 content lives only under benchmarks/datasource/ds2/ with its own version label DS-v2 (manifest.dataset_version)
tc007_ds_v1_immutability.result: clean — no DS-v1 path modified (verified again after the seal landed; see VERIFICATION.md for the exact commands)

spot_check.required: >= 10 expectations across levels and kinds (TC-006 pass condition), human-confirmed against corpus source
spot_check.coverage: both corpora, all four L1 kinds, L5 knowledge, grades 1+2
spot_check.result: 12/12 agree — every target found at its claimed file/line (incl. exact line citations: attrs _make.py:2839 Factory-storing line for I03, _make.py:2038 call site for F02, yarl _url.py:777/788/799/809 credential property defs for K44); grade-2 rows are the load-bearing primary in every case

reproduce: uv run python -c "from collections import Counter; from cairn.eval import load_ground_truth; qs = load_ground_truth('benchmarks/datasource/ds2/ground_truth'); print(len(qs), Counter(q.level for q in qs), Counter(q.kind for q in qs))"
git status --porcelain benchmarks/datasource/t2 benchmarks/quality/ablation.json benchmarks/quality/ablation.md (TC-007: must be empty)

build_facts_verified_against.source_of_record: ground_truth/AUTHORING.md (T008/T009 authoring notes); observed == recorded for both corpora
